definitions.explanation: Negative speech about someone, typically behind their back; verbal abuse or criticism of a person.

examples.english: It's not good to speak ill of others.
examples.notes: 悪口を言う = to speak ill of, to badmouth

examples.english: He was speaking ill of me behind my back.

examples.japanese: {悪口|わるくち}⟦ばかり→ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{信用|しんよう}→信用：03267_shinyou⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can't trust someone who only badmouths others.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{悪口|わるくち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{嫌|いや}な→嫌：10232_iya⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I heard someone badmouthing my friend, and it made me feel really unpleasant.
examples.notes: 悪口を聞く = to hear someone being spoken ill of

examples.japanese: ⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{悪口|わるくち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{卑怯|ひきょう}→卑怯：04345_hikyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think it's cowardly to badmouth someone when they're not around.

notes:
USAGE: {悪口|わるくち} refers to negative speech about someone, especially when said behind their back. It has a clear negative connotation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {悪口|わるくち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to speak ill of, to badmouth)
- {悪口|わるくち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (to hear bad things said about someone)
- ⟦{陰|かげ}→陰：14593_kage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{悪口|わるくち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to speak ill behind someone's back)

READING NOTE: Can also be read as わるぐち, though わるくち is more common.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {悪口|わるくち} - speaking ill of someone
- ⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧ - criticism (more neutral, can be constructive)
- ⟦{陰口|かげぐち}→陰口：06638_kageguchi⟧ - gossip, backbiting (specifically behind someone's back)

cross_references.label: abusive language, verbal abuse, offensive remark
